exposure: Time period (lockdown vs. post-lockdown vs. previous years)
Sunshine Coast University Hospital vs. overall Queensland
cohort: All births in Queensland, Australia, including those at the Sunshine Coast University Hospital, from April to July 2018-2020
finding: There was a significantly higher chance of birth at term and a significant reduction in preterm birth prevalence at the Sunshine Coast University Hospital during both the COVID-19 lockdown and post-lockdown periods compared to previous years, but this trend was not statistically significant for Queensland overall.
mod_finding: This study does not compare outcomes based on mode of delivery, but does find that emergency cesareans concurrently decreased during lockdown.
